name: Icebind Solo
description: The Icebind for 1 to 6 Tenno (opt-in). Ring a Cryobell starts its countdown once every squad member present has offered a Cryobell; the maximum stays 6, and the one-of-each-Warframe rule, voting, tie-break and countdown are stock. In the mission, complication scaling and the Squad Side Objectives (start requirement, Void Surge, Locked Crate, Signal Chain) use the real squad size through the game's own scaling flags instead of a fixed 6, and Cryothermia (Cryo Core) needs 10 s of total hold instead of 60 s (a full squad's per-player share). Six exact-key script replacements for client 44.1.1.
